messages.subject: Static Variables
parts:
Hi All,

   I have been playing around in shiny for few days. Wanted to know if there is any static variables thingy in shiny. basically I want to print current value and the previous value 
For eg

 global.R
 
  test <- 0

  server.R

  fn <- reactive({
      out <- paste( "new :" input$value, " old :", test )
      test <- input$value
      return(out)
  })

 here output is always
  new :1 old :0
  new :2 old :0
  new :3 old :0

  how to retain the old value

Regards,
Ady
